messages:
marta: Quick sync — planning the 'launch ring' activation experiment for next week. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success by 20% and lift 7-day retention for new signups. Hypothesis: combine staggered launch-post cadence + segmented onboarding nudges (in-app + email) + tailored prompt templates to accelerate activation. Short plan below, please chime in.

jamal: Nice. Can we lock down the cohorts and primary metric? Is 'first_success' the right KPI (first meaningful API call or embedding produced)?

marta: Yes, primary metric = event 'first_success' (user completes the sample prompt flow and gets a useful output). Secondary: 7-day active users, 7d retention. Cohorts: A=baseline onboarding, B=prompt-templates nudges, C=launch-post + community CTA.

olivia: I'll own the content calendar + publish schedule. Proposed social cadence: teaser (D-2), launch post (D0), 24h case study snippet (D1), webinar invite (D3). Emails: 0h welcome, 12h nudge (B gets prompt pack), 48h deep-dive for engaged.

nora: Creative gradient: I'll make three versions of the prompt templates (starter, developer, customer-success). ETA: EOD Thurs. Also will prepare 2 hero images and a 30s demo gif.

jamal: Tracking checklist for analytics team: add segment flag 'launch_ring_variant' with values [A,B,C], instrument 'first_success' event, include utm_campaign=launch-ring-2026. Will add a derived funnel in Amplitude.

marta: Good — here's the minimal tracking payload we'll expect from the frontend (please use verbatim keys):

```json
{
  "event": "first_success",
  "user_id": "<uid>",
  "variant": "A|B|C",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-ring-2026",
  "timestamp": "<iso>"
}
```

jamal: I'll ensure backend surfaces `variant` in the events. Also adding a guard so we don't double-count from demo flows.

olivia: Quick question about webinar: do we gate webinar signups behind a short checklist (e.g., 'completed sample prompt') or keep it open? My leaning: gate for B cohort to boost intent signals, keep open for others. Thoughts?

marta: Gate for B makes sense — we want higher intent. For open signups we'll mark 'webinar_lead' but only send the exclusive follow-up email to gated attendees.

nora: Asset checklist in case helpful:
```
Cohort, Onboarding Flow, Email nudge schedule
A, baseline, 0h / 24h / 72h
B, prompt-templates, 0h / 12h / 48h
C, socials-cta, 0h / 36h / 96h
```

deploy-bot: calendar event created: "Launch Ring — cross-functional sync" Monday 11:00 AM. Link: https://calendar.redwood/launch-ring-sync

jamal: Perf note — we should include a short control for API latency so we can attribute activation lifts to UX and not perf improvements. I'll add `median_latency_ms` to logged context.

marta: Love it. Ownership:
- olivia: publish schedule + assets
- nora: creative + prompt packs
- jamal: analytics instrumentation + latency context
- marta: test plan + PRD + report template

olivia: I'll share the content spreadsheet in #marketing-assets and tag you all. Quick ask: can someone draft the webinar 1-pager? I'll assemble slides from that.

nora: I can draft the webinar 1-pager (bullet points + CTA) by Fri morning.

marta: Perfect. Final note on measurement windows: primary analysis at D7, quick health check at D2 and D3. We'll run the experiment for 14 days and then evaluate.

jamal: Sounds good. I'll create temporary Amplitude cohorts and a dashboard.

olivia: :thumbsup: tagging this for the Monday sync. PRD link (working): https://redwood.internal/launch-ring-prd

marta: Thanks — will post a short follow-up with the final asset checklist and tagging. Iterate there. :sparkles:
